```{r}

library(tidyverse)
```

## plot01

```{r}
#| label: plot01

n <- 3
pi <- 0.5
x <- 0:n
y <- dbinom(x, n, pi)
data.frame(x, y) |>
  ggplot() +
    aes(x, y) +
    geom_col(
    	width=1,
      color="black",
      fill="white") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks=x, 
    minor_breaks=NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=(1:3)/8) +
  labs(x="Binomial(n=3, pi=0.5)",
       y="Probability",
       caption="Simon, 2024-11-12") -> plot01

plot01
ggsave("../images/plot01.png")
```

## plot03

```{r}
#| label: plot03

n <- 20
pi <- 0.75
x <- 0:n
y <- dbinom(x, n, pi)
x0 <- seq(0, n, 1000)
y0 <- dnorm(x0, n*pi, sqrt(n*pi*(1-pi)))
normal_curve <- data.frame(x0, y0)
data.frame(x, y) |>
  ggplot() +
    aes(x, y) +
    geom_col(
    	width=1,
      color="black",
      fill="white") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks=x, 
    minor_breaks=NULL) +
  labs(x="Binomial(n=20, pi=0.75)",
       y="Probability",
       caption="Simon, 2024-11-12") -> plot03

plot03
ggsave("../images/plot03.png")
```

## plot04

```{r}
#| label: plot04

plot03 +
  geom_point(
    y=dnorm(
        x, 
        n*pi, 
        sqrt(n*pi*(1-pi))))  -> plot04

plot04
ggsave("../images/plot04.png")
```
